title: Two editors increment the same revision
summary: Four of six legal read/write interleavings lose one increment when a write uses its saved value.

subject.system: Two editors increment the same revision

change.description: Four of six legal read/write interleavings lose one increment when a write uses its saved value.

notes: The independent JVM oracle covered 6 inputs on each revision. current mismatches were 0 for revision. saved mismatches were 4 for revision.

The six inputs are exactly the linear extensions of the two per-editor read-before-write constraints. Each operation is a deterministic transition in this model. Live Java threads and JVM memory ordering require separate evidence.
